# One year / growing population / repeated ACT cases — caller preflight

**2026-10-27 · base83eca29 · pre-code DIAGNOSTIC functional caller, NOT v2 research/confirmation/G1, calibrated humans or security probability.** BACKLOG owns work. Existing Model/EvidenceRelay only; add a reproducible study caller, no runtime framework/backend/API/cache. Fixed design below before first execution; no favorable seed/rate/horizon/budget retry. All economic mutations use Model.

## Fixed scenario and evidence ceiling

H=365days=8760h,60 supplied genesis n00…n59 with0 money/XP, native maturity/guaranteeFee1/reference qualification. Daily Self-ID demand for each accepted person except actual D77 parties and separately declared pre-entry readiness choices. No injected XP/funds or fictitious work income.26 own-source invitations offered days7+14j (j0…25), accepted24h later, creator n55 with actual n58/n59 guarantees purchased day1 at1each. Thus at most86people from DECLARED demand, not an admission cap/safe closed network; actual accepted/funded counts reported. Supplied-world population stays below100, compatible with absent-formal-Council reference; count/XP are not verified independence. General D33/D35/D36/D75 migration and all unresolved rights/merits/termination contracts remain absent.

Public early association: n00…n39; scripted genuine-person coalition: n40…n49; n50…n59 ordinary other people. These are supplied role/control intentions, not guilt/public truth; every subject remains accepted/responsible until an actual authorized consequence. No aliases in this first caller. All parties genuine under evaluator assumptions, no private person/control/validity flag is added to Model or used by defensive policy. Source facts classify ONLY the named disputed local acts, not omnibus correctness of every later personal-chain record. Behavior switch/relapse and private intent are scripted, not learned/endogenous/calibrated.

Early resources are EARNED: n00 opens18 actual outgoing guarantees to n10…n27, one per day1…18. On day1 n02…n17 each transfer1 actual own-earned FACY to n01; n01 opens17 guarantees that day and one per day2…14, eventually30 to n10…n39. Neither transfers nor links give XP; later native source receipts do. Each activation costs actual1. Coalition organizer n40 first issues ordinary sources; day30 pays its30 earned units for30 duties, then day60 pays20 more for50 total outgoing duties to the first50 other subjects excluding n00/self. Recipients consent in this supplied reference; guaranteeing a genuine person does not prove present/future honesty or guilt of that person. No hidden-label filter denies cooperation. No graph-only admission, stipend or subsidy. These fixed responsibility histories may favor either side under encoded XP rules; outcomes/eligibility are observed, not forced.

## Actual case/action tape

All use d77-timed-act-converted/v1 and explicit absent formal Council, never false-person enforcement or a supplied winner. Evidence source/review/entrant judgments are supplied fallible/strategic signal tape, NOT correctness or independent evidence certificates. They are fixed separately from private evaluator validity and read only for that actor's decision. No random draws/seed/accuracy measurement. Public positions/XP/cash drive whether requested opposition is even permitted. A desired side already matching the last position causes abstention, not redundant entry; failed entry cannot create a party or renew time. SourceGroup tags may be supplied by coordinated people and do not establish real independence.

1. defect-old: open day75, n00 against n41 act recorded day60 (supplied local defect). n40 requests valid side day76; n01 requests defect side day77.
2. pressure-a: n40 opens day210 against n20 act190 (supplied valid). n01 requests valid side day211.
3. pressure-b: n40 opens day211 against n22 act191 (supplied valid), potentially overlapping pressure-a with same challenger. n01 requests valid side day212.
4. repeat-defect: n00 attempts day270 against n41 act250 (supplied local relapse). n40 requests valid side271; n01 defect side272. A previously corrected own history may be refused by the CURRENT converted-only profile: retain that unsupported boundary, not an automatic replay or proof of immunity.
5. mistaken-defect: n00 attempts day271 against n21 act251 (supplied valid but misleading report/review). n01 valid side272; n40 defect side273. No guaranteed truthful/protective voting or permanent early-community victory.

Opening signals are supplied suspicious reports plus suspicious distinct-tag sponsor review; a voluntary entrant's private judgment maps to desired defect/valid. Actor code must not read evaluator validity/ownership. Initial60 have finite relay work accounts (100units/actor, reviewCapacity20/day); actual charged/denied work retained. Newborns get ordinary funded admission/sources, not an invented exemption; no later relay-account registration in this first declared action menu and no claim that they are legally barred from intervention. Ordinary Model operations are counted separately, not automatically converted into human effort/FACY expense.

## Chronology, missingness and invariants

Predeclare event hours as union of daily0…H and each day+4h checkpoint. At each hour advance Model; BEFORE H, choose uses for due tracked own rights via public Self-ID snapshots, then actual case entry/finalization and daily actions. Daily automatic maturation/withdrawal precedes actual case requests; a subsequent own-issue request is made only if the person is still unrestricted. This explicit sequential action tape has no competing own-issue command. Failed/matching-side/nonexistent-case requests do not create D77 participation and do NOT force a whole-day readiness pause: this caller lets that person issue afterward if allowed. Report readiness-skipped0 separately from SELECTED D77 pauses rather than silently inventing extra entry friction. Procedural work is still charged by Relay, not assumed to consume a calibrated full human day.

Current Model is authoritative for holds, money/source statuses, eligibility and case history. No omniscient case success override. Finalize only on a declared +4h checkpoint strictly past the recorded deadline, never exactly/on a supplied winner; no later response after expiry. Overlap must keep shared actors held until ALL applicable cases close. No automatic compensation/catch-up or whole-network pause. Uninvolved sources/invitations continue through pending intervals. New case may be unsupported/refused; log exact stage/reason, no fictitious admission/clock/outcome and no conversion to safe0. Keep its public/evaluator scoped affected record status as unknown/outside coverage, not a scientific survival criterion. Model errors/native contract refusals abort that path or run explicitly; external90s timeout has unknown final state, not native censor/safety.

Full Model.audit after EVERY declared event hour (including final H) and after procedural mutation. No mandatory audit removed for speed. Raw daily endpoints expected days1…365 independent of last retained row; include initialization0 separately. Track actual sources, invitations/burn, collection versus debt, XP receipts/halvings/revocations, fees/stakes/refunds/transfers, Model holds/foregone party issuance, readiness skips, relay work and actual attempts/refusals. History/case summaries and provenance must distinguish unavailable/horizon-pending/unsupported from false/zero/safe. Do not compute human profit/equilibrium/attack probability/threshold or declare encoded XP-comparison outcomes emergent.

## Literal acceptance / bound

One process under90s, unchanged declared H/demand/setup/signal/action tape. Fresh annual completion OR bounded noncompletion is retained honestly; do not tune to get all cases admitted/won. Initial money/XP0; all minted units tied to actual Self-ID records. Every invitation funded by a tracked own matured unit, every guarantee/funding transfer actual. Full audits and canonical case/stake/roster/source bindings pass. At H exactly ONLY advance/audit/measurement: no withdrawal, issue/invite/participation command or extra free day. Ordinary24h XP maturity may occur automatically, while original matured Emitter rights remain unwithdrawn until an actual future choice outside the observed horizon. Negative/control assertions may cover unsupported case3 but must not require favorable case winners. Source/test/default/RNG/old packets unchanged; actual caller and manifest have separate reproducibility digests. No research seed or historical replay.

Before scientific interpretation, the existing master/v2/G1/claims/contexts/precision/error/search/held-out/behavior/data gates still apply. This cohort closes only living-population CALLER integration/coverage diagnosis, not sustainable growth, honest advantage, truthful merits, capture resistance or recovery science. The next step is whatever smallest real caller/coverage gap the fixed run exposes, not automatic new modules/actor registries or a favorable rerun.
